sentences.text:
In The High Court At Calcutta
3.10.24
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
S.D
Item no.48
 Crr 2855 of 2024
 Rahul Kundu
 -Vs-
 State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Baidurya Ghosal ......... For the Petitioner.
Learned Advocate for the petitioner is present.
Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner.

Learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that the allegation made against his client is not maintainable and the contents of the complaint will go to show that there are no ingredients of Section 498A/506 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned Advocate draws attention to the petition of complaint and submits that the allegation does not make out a case.
and Upon hearing the learned Advocate and considering the materials on record this court is of the view that this revisional application should be admitted.
Thus I admit this revisional application.
Let notice be issued upon the opposite parties and affidavit of service be filed on the reopening date after vacation.
Let this matter appear as contested application two weeks on reopening after vacation.

Pending hearing of this application there will be stay of further proceedings in G.R. Case No. 1629 of 506 arising out of Bhadreswar Police Station Case No. 532 of 2022 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Chandannagar for a period of four weeks from the date of reopening after vacation.
